description: Vercel is a cloud platform for building, deploying, and scaling web applications and AI workloads. It provides deployment, project, domain, observability, AI gateway, and related platform services for individual accounts and teams.
summary: Vercel exposes a Bearer-token-authenticated REST API at api.vercel.com, an OAuth-protected MCP server at mcp.vercel.com, the `vercel` CLI, and a public AI Gateway model list endpoint at ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models.

surfaces.name: Vercel AI Gateway model list API
